title: Hospital Claims for Patients Warded before MediShield Life Effective Date
what_it_is: Hospital Claims for Patients Warded before MediShield Life Effective Date

sections.label: MediShield transition and financial assistance
sections.summary: Patients admitted before 1 November 2015 keep old MediShield benefits, with subsidies, Medisave, Medifund and case-by-case help available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Individuals with existing MediShield coverage who were admitted before 1 November 2015 will continue to receive benefits under the old MediShield.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: This approach is consistent with the approach taken in past MediShield enhancements and provides a clear transition at the start of MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Significant Government subsidies of up to 80% are also available for those who use subsidised treatment in our public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Patients can also tap on Medisave for their share of the healthcare bills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Again, patients who face financial difficulties can approach the Medical Social Workers at the public hospitals for assistance, such as tapping on Medifund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I can understand the angst of the patient that Mr Lim referred to.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I will encourage the patient or Mr Lim to refer the case to us and we will take a look at the specifics of the case and see how we can help the patient, including providing financial assistance, or looking at other ways to help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The best way is to let us know the specific cases and we will see how we can tailor our assistance scheme to support them.
